description: This file defines the CostandUsageReportServiceClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, used to interact with the AWS Cost and Usage Report Service. It contains method annotations for report management operations and extends the base AwsClient class.

classes.name: CostandUsageReportServiceClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS Cost and Usage Report Service, providing methods for managing reports.

methods.name: deleteReportDefinition
methods.description: Deletes a cost and usage report definition.

methods.name: deleteReportDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a cost and usage report definition.

methods.name: describeReportDefinitionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about report definitions.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specific resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: putReportDefinition
methods.description: Creates or updates a report definition.

methods.name: putReportDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a report definition.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
